description: A table as CSV, ready to save as a file or load into a notebook. The first column is each row's name unless `names` is false. `columns` picks columns by id, in that order. With `proof`, each column is followed by its source and quote, and in a table whose proof is optional, by where each value came from. An empty field means no value.

columns.description: Column ids, from get_table. Leave out for every column

names.description: Whether to start each line with the row's name. Defaults to true

proof.description: Whether to add each value's source, quote and origin. Defaults to false

version.description: A saved version's number, from `versions` in get_table. Leave out for the live table

name: export_table
